description: ACA Health Insurance Marketplace (HealthCare.gov) plans for a US ZIP code from CMS's QHP Landscape data: plan ID and name, issuer, metal level, plan type, monthly premium before subsidies for the nearest published age (0-14, 18, 21, 27, 30, 40, 50, 60) and a couple, deductible, out-of-pocket maximum, copays, silver cost-sharing reductions, phone and plan document links, cheapest first. Federal-platform states only; states that run their own exchange are not covered. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

age.description: Applicant age 0-120 (default 40); premiums are published for 0-14, 18, 21, 27, 30, 40, 50 and 60

county.description: Optional 5-digit county FIPS when the ZIP spans several counties

metal.description: Optional: bronze, expanded bronze, silver, gold, platinum or catastrophic

planType.description: Optional: HMO, PPO, EPO or POS

year.description: Plan year (only the year CMS publishes now)

name: gov_healthcare_gov
title: Gov Healthcare Gov
